subject: QuantCore — Early access sponsorship + trial extension request
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@quantcore.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@quantcore.io
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: early-access sponsorship + trial extension

Hi Jordan,

Appreciate the demo yesterday — the team was impressed. We're at the tail end of a short procurement window and two things are blocking our internal pilot kickoff: (1) our security/compliance team needs a bit more time to finish the questionnaire, and (2) our CTO wants a longer evaluation horizon to validate latency at scale.

QuantCore is asking if Redwood can: 1) extend the hosted trial for an additional 30 days, and 2) provide $25,000 in platform credit to cover token usage during an extended evaluation (we expect usage spikes while running a 48-hour ingest and stress run). In exchange, we are prepared to commit to a 9-month paid pilot immediately after the evaluation if the results look good.

Can you escalate this for an executive sponsorship/authorization? Procurement also included a short questionnaire (attached). We need any commercial concession documented so we can move through legal this week.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
CFO, QuantCore Systems
Attachment: quantcore_procurement_questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 72KB)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00

Marissa — forwarding QuantCore's ask. Quick summary: $25k credits + 30-day hosted trial extension in exchange for an immediate 9-month paid pilot commitment (they'll sign once commercial terms are documented). Opportunity is likely mid-market financial services vertical; ARR upside estimated ~$320k.

Impact/notes:
- Expected token burn for 30-day extension with their planned ingest: ~1.2M tokens (~$12k nominal) but we want to cover spikes.
- Proposed commercial concession we can offer: $25k credits up-front, 20% discount on list pricing for first 6 months of the pilot (applied to usage), and a requirement they sign a 9-month pilot SOW with a minimum commitment.
- Requires exec approval because credits + discount combined exceed standard SDR manager authority. Legal will need to sign the term sheet; procurement attached questionnaire.

Attachments: proposed_term_sheet_v1.pdf (draft)

Can you confirm whether we can clear this? If yes I’ll push DocuSign and loop legal/CS for SLA details.

— Jordan
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Thanks for the context. A few questions before I greenlight:

1) Can you confirm the net revenue expectation vs. concession? Put simply: if we give $25k credit + 20% off for 6 months, what is the expected net realized revenue over the 9-month pilot? (need simple math for the board deck).
2) Is there a requirement to cover support hours or SLA beyond standard trial? If yes, outline incremental costs.
3) Are there known compliance or data residency asks beyond their questionnaire?

Assuming:
- They commit to minimum monthly spend after the extension (e.g., $25k total over pilot) and
- Legal can accept our standard pilot SOW with the concession recorded in the term sheet

If those boxes are checked, I can approve the sponsorship. Priyom/Aditya — pls weigh in on margin impact and legal risk.

— Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: early-access sponsorship + trial extension

Marissa / Jordan,

Quick finance check:
- $25k credit hit recognized over the pilot period — expected revenue deferral but acceptable given the projected ARR.
- 20% discount for first 6 months on expected pilot usage (we modeled conservative usage): gross revenue expected $180k across 9 months; with concessions net ~$145k. Incremental gross margin remains >45% under conservative estimates.
- Legal risk: minimal — standard pilot SOW with concession memo is sufficient. No unusual indemnities in their questionnaire.

Recommend approval with two conditions: (1) require the customer to sign the attached term sheet AND the DocuSign before we apply credits; (2) set an automatic reversion: discount drops to list price after 6 months and credits expire at the end of the extension.

— Priyom
Head of Revenue Ops (acting)

Lena — appreciate the details and the quick turnaround. We will approve the early-access sponsorship under the following conditions:

1) Redwood will apply $25,000 in platform credits to QuantCore's account to cover trial usage during the 30-day extension period.
2) QuantCore will receive a 20% discount on usage for the first six months of the paid pilot, which must follow immediately after the extended trial.
3) QuantCore agrees to sign the attached pilot SOW and term sheet (DocuSign link below) within 72 hours; credits will be applied only after countersignature.
4) The discount automatically reverts to standard list pricing after six months; any unused credits expire after the extension window.

Jordan / Priyom — Jordan please: 1) send the DocuSign, 2) ensure Legal attaches the concession memo to the SOW, and 3) CS to schedule an onboarding sync for the first week of the paid pilot.
